recognize_zh: 骨髓抽吸抹片中央有一顆巨大的前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），胞質深藍、邊緣帶小突起，細胞核大而染色質呈均質淡染的玻璃樣外觀（核內病毒包涵體），像提燈般的「lantern cell」，提示微小病毒 B19 感染。
features: Giant pronormoblast, several times the size of surrounding cells, with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and a scalloped edge
Large round nucleus with pale, glassy, finely stippled chromatin (intranuclear viral inclusion) replacing normal chromatin detail
Nucleolus obscured; thin rim of darker cytoplasm around the nucleus
Surrounding smaller erythroid and myeloid precursors with coarse chromatin
Image is slightly oversaturated and out of focus, limiting fine chromatin assessment
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a giant pronormoblast with intensely basophilic cytoplasm and a large nucleus containing pale, glassy chromatin consistent with an intranuclear viral inclusion. The surrounding marrow contains smaller hematopoietic precursors, and later-stage erythroid maturation is not prominent in this field. Image focus and color saturation limit detailed assessment. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection; confirmation with parvovirus immunohistochemistry, serum PCR, and reticulocyte count is recommended.

ddx.vs: Shows sheets of proerythroblasts with vacuolated cytoplasm and TP53 abnormalities rather than scattered giant cells with glassy nuclear inclusions.
Megaloblasts show open sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony across all erythroid stages, without glassy inclusions or erythroid aplasia.
Tumor cells are cohesive and megakaryoblasts have cytoplasmic blebs with CD61+, lacking an intranuclear viral inclusion.
Normal pronormoblasts are smaller with visible nucleoli and fine but not glassy chromatin.
